notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.
notes: If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Lotus Cobra's trigger.

feature.name: Infinite mana lands you control can produce

notablePrerequisites:
There are two mana-producing land cards in your graveyard.
There are three or more card types among cards in your graveyard excluding the "Creature" type.
description:
Play Lotus Field. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Lotus Field trigger, sacrificing it and Echoing Deeps.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
When Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field enter, they each trigger.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps, Lotus Field and two other mana-producing lands except Shifting Woodland by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field triggers, sacrificing them and the lands tapped for mana in step 6.
Activate Shifting Woodland's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 5.

feature.name: Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield

easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
